#  41106 - Biology Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41106**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Biology**  |  
|  Biologie   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr. rer. nat. Bucher, Roman 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  |  The objective is to give an overview of organismic, cellular, and molecular biology in order to enable students to understand fundamental biological structures and processes from the molecular to the organismic level. Students will be able
  * to understand and explain the basic principles of the lecture topics,
  * to work with microscopes under bright field, dark field and phase contrast conditions,
  * to explain selected methods in the field of organismic, molecular, and cellular biology,
  * to find and work with scientific sources concerning current biological knowledge.

 |  
| Contents:  |  **Part 1: Lecture**
  * Molecules that are relevant for biology
  * Cells – the basic units of life (compartments and structures)
  * Organismic organisation and biodiversity
  * Basic principles in genetics and molecular biology
  * Energy, enzymes, and metabolism
  * Land plants / vascular plants
  * Animals: immunology, development, and physiology

**Part 2: Practical Training**
  * Light microscopy, basic techniques
  * Advanced microscopical techniques (staining, counting)
  * Determination of animals
  * Plant anatomy and physiology
  * Cell growth
  * Mitosis
  * Parasites
  * Animal preparation

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Basic knowledge in natural sciences (biology, chemistry, physics) is strongly recommended!  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Excursion / 2 Hours 
  * Practical training / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 118 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  |  Students will acquire the general principles through the lecture. By means of the lecture notes and relevant textbooks, a self-directed continuous study is necessary. In the practical exercises, students have to work with course microscopes and other selected methods. Copies of relevant literature can be found in the library ("Semesterapparat"). Main Text books (latest editions are recommended):
  * Purves, W.K. ; Sadava, D.; Orians, G. M.; Heller M. C. 2004. Life – The Science of Biology. 7th edition. Sunderland.
  * Sadava, D.; Heller, M. C.; Orians, G. M.; Purves, W. K.; Millis, D. M. 2006. Life – The Science of Biology. 8th edition. Sunderland. 
  * Campbell, N.A. & Reece, J.B. 2005. Biology. 7th edition. San Francisco.

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  Prerequisite:
  * successful participation in the practical exercises (>80%)

Final module examination:
  * Written examination, 120 minutes.

The examination is to be carried out in presence (e-examination).  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |
